notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 | Voice+Noise Meter, 5 Perk Slots, Tab Menu, Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
This is a little update to add some quality of life features, make the game more fun and to fix some more bugs.

1.1.0 Patch Notes:

Added a Noise Meter to display the amount of noise you make with your actions (and voice)

All Entities now hear Voice Chat and will react to it

There are now 5 Perk slots instead of 3, unlocked one after another at player levels 2, 4, 8, 10, 15

Added 4 new Perks:

Long Arms: Increases Interaction Range by up to 50%

Stronk: Increases Throw Distance by up to 200% (careful lol)

Bodylight: Much requested, Attach a flashlight to your body which is always active and doesn't take up an inventory slot

Spidey Sense: Gain the ability to sense the Entity when it starts hunting for up to 20 seconds.

Panic Pro Perk was bugged and was active all the time (giving +150% cleaning speed 24/7, what the hell) instead of just being active when an entity is nearby.

Added a Tab-Button Menu: Shows Player info (who has which key, player name, level, prestige)

The Tab Menu also shows your own keys as a little inventory from which you can drop keys

Energy Drink Rework: Previously, energy drinks only refilled your stamina. That was very situational and didn't feel very powerful or fun. They now additionally grant a buff that increases movement speed by a percentage for a duration. Previously players needed an extra perk for that, instead that perk now drastically increases the power and duration of the buff.

Cult carnage entities hunt duration increased to 90seconds (was 60). Cult Carnage Maps are bigger so their entities just need some additional time to lurk around

Physics Tweaks to fix annoying bugs (fingers crossed)

A new Outfit for all characters + recolors, available at Prestige 1

reworked UV Light logic, deleted a lot of unnecessary stuff, it works simpler now and it just works better because of that.

fixed several bugged spawn locations for cult symbols and ectoplasms

fixed a bug causing the match to not end when all players are knocked down

you can no longer join matches mid match because it caused tons of issues

player names above the characters heads are now visible in the lobby, too

fixed an issue causing some keybinds not to work properly




As always, I hope I didn't break anything else and I am looking forward to your feedback. :)  

Cheers, 
Beepbep

notes.title: Patch 1.0 | Bye, bye Early Access
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Paranormal Cleanup is officially out of Early Access! It's time for Patch 1.0!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43225143/3075b4d8bbfdced391183a5e360a25900951ff64.jpg

Remember how it all started?
0.0.1 launched February 2023 in a bare-bones state with the simple objective to clean up trash piles and trash bags on a single map, a house haunted by an old lady. Nothing else. I think there wasn't even a way to set your keybinds. 

What about now? What's in the game?
 5 Maps with unique enemies that have their own behavior, abilities, looks, sounds and jumpscares
 Several things to clean, from dirty toilets to ectoplasm and bloody symbols
 Dynamic, interactive environments with a lot of interactable items
 Unique Banish Mechanics on each map to get rid of every entity, like burning down an art studio to destroy cursed paintings
 A new interactive lobby to hang out in, no boring static menu
 Proximity Voice Chat
 We (you and I) iterated through several Objective Systems over the years, from randomized contracts to now full on cleaning jobs where you have to clean a percentage of everything there is to complete your job
 Player Perks, so you can play just the way you want to. Want to clean faster while an entity is near or would you rather be able to run faster after cleaning something?
 Equipment Upgrades: Permanent improvements to your gear
 Daily & Weekly Tasks to gain additional EXP and $$
 So many Achievements with ingame rewards

New with 1.0
 A Prestige System so you can grind endlessly and get sweet cosmetics
 Character Outfits
 Hard Mode: Up to the Challenge? Unbanishable Entities that hunt non-stop.. for double the job reward
 Bug Fixes

BUT, there's still some stuff missing that I promised for the launch, that isn't in the game yet. All that is coming in the next couple weeks, I am working hard to get it done as soon as possible, this is my top priority.

Coming in the next couple weeks
 3 New Maps, yes, not one, 3!
 A new Objective, including a new cleaning item and upgrades for it
 Localization
 Controller Rework/Tweaks/Fixes
 Steam Deck Verified
 New Character Skins
 Equipment Skins
 ..and more, based on your feedback :)

Let's sneak a look at one of the new maps

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43225143/ca08703442d80aa4469c9cccef09fa9e4d9cd40a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43225143/598333beaa35d54014c410d820dc600ad63d71c9.png

Thank you all for your patience and endless support. Thank you for all the great feedback in the last couple months, it's been amazing doing this for you.

Have fun playing, and as always, see you in game!
Cheers,

thanks again for all the bug reports and suggestions, your help means the world to me! Took me a bit longer than I hoped to get this patch out the door but I think this time I really managed to fix the most frequent crash issues, which was a big priority for me.

0.4.0 Patch Notes:

 You can now banish the entities on 'Whispering Studio' and 'Ritual Row'
 'Whispering Studio' and 'Ritual Row' have been polished and updated
 FINALLY fixed the map transition FatalError bug (caused by AudioThread & VoiceChat btw)
 Not the first time I said this but this time I actually fixed the game breaking objective spawn bug for ectoplasm, cult symbols and banish items
 added 2 UV Lamps to each map which you can carry around to see Ectoplasm even when an entity isn't hunting
 all entities (besides the butcher) now have hunt and lurk phases (means cult guys dont hunt all the time anymore, but the butcher does because thats just his thing)
 You now need to clean at least 50% on each map to be able to win
 Hunts now start a bit later and are shorter initially but get longer with each hunt
 Entities now gain movespeed the longer they chase you
 Oh, you can jump now.
 ..but also can the entities
 made some general changes to physics actors to prevent them from clipping through the floor
 changes/tweaks to audio attenuation and concurrency
 more general GPU and CPU optimizations (improved culling, more/better mesh LODs, smaller textures, reduced drawcalls by around 50% on every map, ..), game is also a bit bigger again(uncompressed) but in turn loads stuff a bit better so D3D timeout crashes might happen less frequent
 removed the red entity post process effect for now because it was waaaay too unoptimized and in some cases cost up to 20FPS
 fixed a bug causing voice chat to be active all the time even when using push to talk
 minor animation tweaks for all entities
 aand as always a lot of smaller tweaks/changes in the background as well as minor bug fixes I totally didn't forget about



Thanks again for your help! I am looking forward to your continued feedback. 

Have fun playing and see you ingame! :)

Cheers,

notes.title: Massive Update Now Live! | Patch 0.3.6
notes.notes:
Hey everybody,

It’s been way too long, but the wait is finally over. Today's update brings a full rework of the game’s core systems, maps, progression, and content.

But this is just the beginning. This update marks the start of the Road to 1.0, which is leading up to the game's Launch in May! We are starting out with a huge accumulation of updates and changes I should have released in small increments over the last year. There's still work to do, but at this point I think its best to release what's there and iterate and improve together.

 0.3.6 Patch Notes:

 Reworked Objective System
- No more seperate jobs, now its just 1 big workload on each map. Because of that you can leave when you cleaned a certain minimum amount (depends on the map) If you get out alive, you get paid depending on the % you cleaned.

 Fully Reworked Lobby (walkable and interactive!)
 - Bye bye boring menu, welcome brand new playable/walkable lobby. Make yourself at home in your new garage and center of operations.

 Two new maps: Walnut Street & Lawrence Drive
- Both plagued by a satanic cult. On both Maps there are multiple buildings to clean, perfect fit for the new objective system

 Two new objectives: Clean ectoplasm and paint over satanic cult symbols
 - Ectoplasm is only visible when there is active paranormal activity (but when testing we figured there should be a way to make it visible when there's not an entity nearby or hunting, so some kind of UV Perk/Item is coming soon)

 Finally, grandma isnt spooking around every house anymore: Unique enemies for each map with their own behavior, abilities, looks, sounds, jumpscares.

 Upgrade your Gear: Items can now be permanently upgraded at the workbench in your garage.

 Reworked and upgradeable Perks: Unlock Perks in the new perk tree and upgrade them (some up to 10 times)

 The Banish Mechanic: Complete unique objectives to weaken or banish the enemy. At the moment only on the first map in which you have to find 5 very hidden cursed toys and burn them in a fire. I will work my way through all the other maps and give each one the same kind of polish and rework the first map got.

 More Interactive Environment: More stuff to interact with, more stuff happening around you.

 Random Daily & Weekly Tasks with XP/$ rewards

 Maaany new Achievements as well as XP/$ Rewards for them

 Many, many smaller changes, across the board bug fixes, graphics improvements, performance improvements, network improvements, new settings, smoother camera/less headbobbing, UI improvements, new and improved physics Interactions, and so much more I forgot since the last update 14 months ago (damn its been long)


So, as I said, this is a rolling content update as we move toward a full 1.0 launch in May. Some features are already live, some are unfinished but also in already(we are still in early access after all), others are dropping over the next weeks.
The game will improve rapidly from now on.

Your feedback is more valuable than ever. Bug reports, suggestions, memes, whatever - bring it all.

Thank you so much for sticking around. See you ingame!

Cheers,
Beepbep

notes.title: Patch 0.2.0 | Perks, Items, New Map, AI Fixes & More
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

The new update is finally here! :)

0.2.0 Patch Notes:

🔥 Perk Up!
Introducing 15 Player Perks! Mix, match, and equip up to 3 to become the cleaning sensation you were always meant to be. Tailor your playstyle just how you like it.

🏠 New Map Alert: 47 Stafford Lane
Once the residence of an artist with a troubled mind, known for captivating and unsettling paintings. The house has been left eerily pristine since her unexplained disappearance.

🚽 New Objective: The Toilet Nightmare
Super disgusting clogged toilets are here. But fear not! Arm yourself with the all-new Plunger. It's... a glamorous job. But someones got to do it. And that someone is you.

🗺️ New Job Selection – Unlock As You Go
Instead of the previous Random Contracts, you will now unlock jobs and locations as you progress. To simplify things the previous 5 difficutlies have been removed and reworked into just "Normal" and "Hard". 
Random Contracts will return soon in a more polished way.

💰 Cha-Ching! You Can Now Earn Money
Get ready to fill your virtual pockets! Earn money to unlock Perks and buy Equipment!

🌟 Gain Experience and Money for Every Little Thing
Cleaning up Trash, collecting Keys, .. every chore counts.

🛒 More Items and a Shop
Buy equipment in the shop before a job or just find items lying around at job locations. Say hello to the Energy Drink, Crowbar, Vacuum Cleaner, and Large Flashlight. And more Items are already on the way!

🤖 AI Got Smarter (and Creepier)
The Ghost recieved another little brain boost. Fixed a lot of bugs and tweaked her behaviour. 

🔧 And So Much More...
Bug fixes? Check. Forgotten changes? Probably a lot. Let's just say I've been busy. Reworked a lot of stuff and got rid of many more little annoying things.
Also:
- Keys are now more visible. If you still have trouble finding some items, try the new "Eagle Eye" Perk to highlight items around you
- More Inventory slots, so you can properly carry all those new items
- New Short Cinematic Intros
- New Radio Voice Lines for each job and Location
- Various Level Art and Level Design Updates
- Little new Obstacle: Wood Planks are now blocking some paths and rooms. Use the new Crowbar item to get rid of them. Either buy it in the shop before a job or find it lying around at the job location


Thats it for this patch!
If you encounter any bugs, feel free to report them in the steam discussions or join me and the others over at discord. 

You can see the current game version in the main menu's bottom right corner.
If Steam doesn't update the game automatically, just restart Steam and the game should start updating.

Thanks for playing and have fun!

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0 | New Map, New Objectives, New Difficulties, Lore
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

This is a big one. And I am already working on the next big update, stay tuned!

0.1.0 Patch Notes:
New Map
- Added a new huge map. If you liked the Map Sizes of "Lunch Lady", this is for you.
"22 Willow Lane"
A duplex that's fallen into disrepair. One side just renovated, the other still abandoned. Both haunted by the past.

Lore
- From now on every map has a unique backstory, revealing the chilling past of each location.
- You can now find collectible lore items as side-objective for additional experience and new achievements

New Objective
- Moldy Pizza! Find and interact with the Pizza to dispose it. 

Contracts
- Introducing Contracts, the new Job Selection. 
- Contracts are randomly generated and grant you unique playthroughs. They differ in Map, Objectives (+ the amount of objectives) and Difficulty. 
Please keep in mind that as there are only 2 Maps and 3 Objectives as of now the Contracts aren't that different at the moment. As I will add more Content that will change. In the future I want to also add additional components to Contracts to make them even more unique.

Difficulties
- Difficulty is now called "Paranormal Level", indicating how strong the entity you will encounter on your job will be and is on a scale from 1 to 5, a Paranormal Level of 5 is the hardest.
- Closets are now 100% safe on lower Paranormal Levels

UI Changes
- Made some changes to the InGame UI, rearranged some stuff and added some new ideas. The UI will still see a lot more changes until the full release of the game.

Fixes, Tweaks, Other Stuff
- Added a screenshake when an entity is near you for more drama
- fixed an issue with the friend invite UI
- added new achievements for the new content
- fixed a lot of collision issues with item spawns and furniture
- Garage Doors won't close anymore when the Electricity shuts off
- When the game ends you wont get jumpscared anymore
